newsitem.title: PARAGUAY: Paraguay's industrial output down in September.
newsitem.headline: Paraguay's industrial output down in September.

text.p: Paraguay's industries reported lower production in the January-September period than in the same period of 1995, according to Central Bank figures released Monday.

Monthly cumulative figures showed a 3.0 percent fall in beverage production, an 8.0 percent drop in wheat byproducts, an 18.0 percent decline in tobacco, and a 0.3 percent decrease in beef, all compared with the first nine months of 1995.
The Central Bank does not release a general index for industrial activity.
